notes: every chart: chart._ssr false, env.node off, 400 x 300.
each state samples the clock at its samplesMs after its setOption (the first, then each merge at the instant the previous state's last sample left).
a custom series' renderItem is a JavaScript function here and a Pascal handler in the port.

cases.note: graphic keyframes: a missing 0% (from the current value) with a keyframe's easing; keyframes out of order with a bounceOut one and the clip's quadraticInOut; style colours and opacity with the shape and a delay; points of changing length; extra, a number and a discrete text; a text's discrete text and its fontSize; the enter duration when none is written (600); a group (no style, no shape); a cubic-bezier keyframe; an array of two on the root (the second stops the first's x)
animation off: no keyframe runs, every element at its own props

loops: x out and back with a delay; y and opacity with no 0% and no 100% keyframe; a shape and a colour under sinusoidalInOut; a full turn -- then an update mid-loop: a new non-looping keyframe from the restored x; a style change that stops and restores (no keyframe); 'all' with a keyframe on the opacity the update transition animates (its track stopped back to its start); a transition on x beside a root keyframe on x (a root keyframe does not stop it)

additive updates: x 0 to 200 over 1000 ms, then 300 ms in an additive 400 ms to 100 (ending first: the track it adds to is finished with it), an additive 1200 ms cubicOut to 50 (ending last), an additive colour, and the same move without additive (the first one stopped)

the transition language on extra and 'all': extra's enterFrom with an enterAnimation; transition 'all' moving extra; extra.transition naming one key; the word 'extra' with an updateAnimation and a delay; style.transition 'all' and shape.transition 'all'; the words 'shape' and 'style'; then removes with a leaveTo on extra and on the style given in the remove itself, and one with none

custom elements: a looping rotation and opacity with a textContent keyframing its fill; a circle's shape keyframes with an elasticOut keyframe; a group scaling once with a looping child and a child on the series' duration (800) -- then new data: every element stopped and restored before the default ['x', 'y'] transition, the circle (now below 100) keyframes no more, the others start again
custom transitions: extra with its enterFrom, transition ['x', 'extra']; a circle with shape.transition 'all' and style.transition 'all' under an additive updateAnimation, updated twice 200 ms apart

guards.name: a missing 0% starts from the current x
a keyframe's cubicOut eases its segment
keyframes are sorted by percent: rotation starts at 1
the order case ends at its 100% keyframe
a colour keyframe interpolates in rgba
points keep the length of the last keyframe where it is shorter
no duration takes the enter duration (600)
a group keyframes its scale, not a style it has not
the second root keyframe animation stops the first on x
the first root keyframe animator of two is gone once its x is stopped
a loop with no 0% starts from the current y
a new keyframe starts from the restored x
an update without a keyframe restores
the restored r is where the update transition starts
a keyframe on the opacity stops the update transition there
a root keyframe beside a transition on x
an additive move adds to the running one
an additive track that ends first finishes the one it adds to
without additive the first one stops
a remove with none is gone at once
the series' duration for a keyframe with none
custom: no keyframe on the next render stops it
